raw_comment:
I noticed that the majority of severe droughts are located in the central United States, in the far north and far south. I also noticed a small area of severe drought southeast of Ohio. 
I wonder why the droughts are happening and how they compare to other droughts in the U. S. over the years. I also wonder why places in the north (like Michigan) are having bad droughts even though they have an abundance of fresh water. I wonder if the droughts have anything to do with population since many of them are in places that are not densely populated. 
Droughts are a nationwide issue and affect most of the country. The community can do something about whatever is causing these issues in order to stop it.
Headline: Disastrous Drought: Why is the United States is Facing Severe Lack of Water?
